title: Soest
description: A medieval town in Westphalia with a small technical university campus, quiet streets and easy access to the Ruhr region.
html:
A walled town in the countryside

Soest is one of the best-preserved medieval towns in western Germany, with a complete town wall, green sandstone churches and a market that has run since the Middle Ages. It has about 50,000 residents, lies between the Ruhr region and the Sauerland hills, and offers a slower pace than the industrial cities to its west.

Studying and working here

The local campus of a regional university of applied sciences focuses on engineering, agriculture and business, with several international programmes and a reputation for close supervision. Dortmund is 40 minutes away by train, which puts the job market of the whole Ruhr region within reach while rents stay low. Students describe the community as small and easy to join.
